nusmp.skill.book_ash.description: A grimoire of Ash Magic, the cursed ash of Zora Ideale's Fire-derived magic. Bullets of ash that blind, a cloud to vanish in that leaves a trap behind, a ring of cursed ash that drinks the mana of whoever stands in it, the Revelation of the Cowardly whose traps spring on whoever strikes you, a shroud of charcoal and ash trees forged piece by piece, soldiers of ash and a curse on one foe. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_bullets: Ash Bullets: a spray of six ash bullets, each hurting a little and blinding for a moment. Damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_cloud: Ash Cloud: you vanish in a cloud of ash for four seconds. Foes within five blocks are blinded and lose track of you, the cloud keeps blinding for three seconds, an ash trap stays armed under it for thirty seconds, and the ash shroud forms round you for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_absorbing_format: Ash Absorbing Formation: a ring of cursed ash for eight seconds where you aim. It drinks three percent of the mana of every foe inside each second and pours it into you, withers them, and turns enemy shots to ash. Radius scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_ash.revelation_of_the_co: Revelation of the Cowardly: for thirty seconds the next three foes who strike you set off an ash trap (damage, blindness, wither, a glow), and everything hidden nearby glows. The ash shroud forms round you for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_shroud: Ash Shroud: nine seconds of charcoal armour cracked with embers and the bare branches of an ash tree on your back, forged piece by piece. Damage resistance, a hit harder, and whatever strikes you in melee withers.
nusmp.page.book_ash.ash_soldiers: Ash Soldiers: two soldiers of ash rise and fight for fifteen seconds (longer with EP): each walks to the nearest hostile and strikes it, withering it, and crumbles when it ends.
nusmp.page.book_ash.cursed_ash: Cursed Ash: cursed ash on the foe you look at: damage, wither II for five seconds and six percent of its mana drained into you (two percent on a boss).
